# John M. Weber

> Operator, investor, and board advisor with three decades of experience building, running, and growing businesses in industrial equipment, commercial services, and business consulting, primarily in the $3-$450M Small to Medium Business revenue range.

John M. Weber has led organizations as President, co-founded ventures from scratch, and built an ownership stake in commercial services businesses. He is not a theoretical advisor: he has managed P&Ls, hired and let go of people, built sales teams, navigated vendor relationships, and made the calls that keep a business moving. Today he is selectively pursuing board seats, investment partnerships, and executive coaching engagements, primarily in industrial services, commercial trades, and the broader Small to Medium Business space. He is based in the Southwest and open to opportunities across the US.

By the numbers (as stated on the site): 5+ companies led or founded, 5 industries served, a $3-$450M revenue range served, and 3 active board seats.

Full about section: https://johnweber.biz/#about

## Experience

- [Southwest Equipment Group](https://www.swequipmentgroup.com): President (Leadership Role). Led the organization at the executive level, overseeing operations, strategy, and business development across the industrial equipment sector, in a competitive Small to Medium Business environment. Tags: Industrial Equipment, Process Engineering.
- [Daisy Industrial Services](https://www.daisyindustrial.com): Co-Founder & Managing Partner (Founder). Co-founded and built an industrial services company from the ground up, shaping the business model, building the team, and developing the client relationships that drove growth.
- [J Weber Consulting](https://www.johnweberconsulting.com/): President (Principal). Provided executive-level business management consulting to organizations across sales, operations, and growth strategy, working directly with owner-operators and leadership teams in the $3-$450M range.
- [Restaurant Equipment & Commercial HVAC](https://knoermechanical.com/): Investor and Board Member (Ownership & Operations). Holds an ownership stake and board-level role, providing strategic oversight and governance input to the leadership team.
- Private Company Board Member: Current Board Member (Board Service). Currently serving as a board member for a private company (not named on the site), providing strategic oversight, governance input, and operator perspective.
- [West Valley Mavericks Foundation](https://www.westvalleymavericksfoundation.org/): Past President (2021-2022) & Board Member (Non-Profit Leadership). Led the organization's mission and operations during the 2021-2022 term; continues to serve on the Board.

Full experience section: https://johnweber.biz/#experience

## Opportunities

John is selectively looking for:

- Board Director Opportunities: serving on the boards of private companies as a Director, in Small to Medium Business companies ($3-$450M), owner-operated or PE-backed, in industries he knows well.
- Business Investment: partnering with entrepreneurs and investors on industrial, trades, or services businesses with growth potential, open to geography across the US, preferring an operator + advisor role.
- Executive Coaching & Mentoring: working with owner-operators scaling up or executives navigating transitions, on sales, operations, or strategy, in structured or as-needed engagements.

Full opportunities section: https://johnweber.biz/#opportunities

## Board Perspective

What John says he brings to the boardroom: operator instincts (real-world experience running businesses, not just advising them), cross-industry depth (industrial, trades, and consulting), a sales and revenue focus, and straight talk (direct, constructive input without the corporate filter).
